user.title: Presence Simulator
user.description: Pick the area(s) to learn from, the day in history to copy, and the part of each day to learn. Each change becomes a scene in scenes.yaml, triggered by an automation in automations.yaml at the same time of day, so both can be edited in the scene and automation editors.

data_description.source_date: Must still be inside the recorder's retention window (purge_keep_days, default 10).
data_description.source_days: Learn this many consecutive days starting at the date above. Use 7 to get one of each weekday.
data_description.window_start: Set both to 00:00 to learn the whole day.
data_description.window_end: An end time earlier than the start crosses midnight (e.g. 18:00 to 01:00).

error.no_domains: Select at least one entity type.
error.future_date: The date can't be in the future.
error.beyond_retention: That date is older than the recorder keeps history for.
error.no_entities: No enabled entities of the selected types were found in those areas.
error.yaml_not_loaded: The scene and automation integrations must be loaded (scenes.yaml / automations.yaml included in configuration.yaml).

data.restore_on_stop: Restore previous states when simulation is switched off
data.off_at_end: Turn everything off at the end of the window

data_description.merge_seconds: Changes this close together become one scene (e.g. walking in and turning on two lamps).
data_description.jitter_minutes: 0 = exact original time. Otherwise each scene fires up to this many minutes late, never past the next scene.
data_description.window_start: Set both to 00:00 to learn the whole day.
data_description.window_end: An end time earlier than the start crosses midnight (e.g. 18:00 to 01:00).
data_description.off_at_end: Adds a final scene at the window's end time so nothing is left on overnight.

error.no_domains: Select at least one entity type.
error.future_date: The date can't be in the future.
error.beyond_retention: That date is older than the recorder keeps history for.
error.no_entities: No enabled entities of the selected types were found in those areas.
error.yaml_not_loaded: The scene and automation integrations must be loaded (scenes.yaml / automations.yaml included in configuration.yaml).

activate_scene.name: Activate learned scene
activate_scene.description: Turn on a Presence Simulator scene by its unique id (used by the generated automations).

scene_id.name: Scene id
scene_id.description: The id of the scene in scenes.yaml.
